## What does this improve?

Describe the change and who it helps. Small fixes and first contributions are
welcome.

## How did you check it?

Describe the review or checks you ran. For source changes, link official
evidence. For translation changes, name the language and pages. For UI changes,
screenshots and desktop/mobile checks are useful.

## Anything still uncertain?

Mention any remaining questions or limitations. Link a related issue if there
is one.
